# V1.8.10

Section: Source

**V1.8.10** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on September 29th, 2023.

## V1.8.10

- Fix - [#20218](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20218) Rotated and mirrored hinge connectors not working
- Fix - [#20274](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20274) Zoom not cleared after opening map/pause menu
- Fix - [#20355](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20355) Modular engine cylinder prices
- Fix - [#20365](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20365) Ammo belt rendering in editor F11 export mesh mode
- Fix - [#18921](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/18921) Simplified map tooltips to Location
- Fix - [#20385](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/20385) Fixed missing logic links on oil rig preset vehicle
